use py:statistics as stats
use go:strings as gstr
use go:math as gmath
use rs:std.str as rstr
use rs:std.i64 as ri

unit ms
unit s = 1000 ms

record Sample {
    service: Text
    ms: Int
    offset: Int
}

record Request {
    sla_s: Float
    samples: List[Sample]
}

record EnrichedSample {
    service: Text
    ms: Int
    offset: Int
    breach: Bool
    exempted: Bool
    overage: Int
    bucket_zero: Bool
    sev: Text
    valid_label: Bool
}

fn sla_to_ms(sla_s: Float) -> Float[ms] pure = (sla_s as s) to ms

fn is_breach(sample_ms: Int, sla_ms: Float[ms]) -> Bool pure =
    (to_float(sample_ms) as ms) > sla_ms

fn is_exempt(service: Text, bucket_zero: Bool) -> Bool pure =
    service == "healthcheck" and bucket_zero

fn severity(sample_ms: Int) -> Text pure = cases sample_ms {
    < 200 => "ok"
    <= 500 => "warn"
    <= 1000 => "slow"
    else => "critical"
}

fn round_even_int(x: Float) -> Int = to_int(gmath.RoundToEven(x))

fn norm_service(name: Text) -> Text = rstr.to_lowercase(gstr.TrimSpace(name))

fn is_valid_label(name: Text) -> Bool =
    let n = rstr.len_chars(name) in
    n >= 2 and n <= 12

fn enrich(sample: Sample, sla_ms: Float[ms], sla_ms_int: Int) -> EnrichedSample =
    let service = norm_service(sample.service) in
    let bucket_zero = ri.rem_euclid(sample.offset, 4) == 0 in
    let raw_breach = is_breach(sample.ms, sla_ms) in
    let exempted = raw_breach and is_exempt(service, bucket_zero) in
    let breach = raw_breach and (exempted == false) in
    EnrichedSample(
        service: service,
        ms: sample.ms,
        offset: sample.offset,
        breach: breach,
        exempted: exempted,
        overage: if breach then sample.ms - sla_ms_int else 0,
        bucket_zero: bucket_zero,
        sev: severity(sample.ms),
        valid_label: is_valid_label(service)
    )

let req: Request = from_json(stdin_text())
let sla_ms: Float[ms] = sla_to_ms(req.sla_s)
let sla_ms_int: Int = round_even_int(scalar(sla_ms))
let items: List[EnrichedSample] = [enrich(x, sla_ms, sla_ms_int) for x in req.samples]

let summary = summarize x in items {
    total: count
    breaches: count where x.breach
    overage_ms: sum x.overage where x.breach
    max_ms: max x.ms default 0
    bucket_zero: count where x.bucket_zero
    critical: count where x.sev == "critical"
    warn_or_worse: count where x.sev != "ok"
    invalid_labels: count where x.valid_label == false
    exempt: count where x.exempted
}

fn overall_status(consecutive_breaches: Int, critical: Int, breaches: Int, invalid_labels: Int) -> Text pure = (
    if consecutive_breaches >= 2 or critical > 0 then "red"
    else if breaches > 0 or invalid_labels > 0 then "yellow"
    else "green"
)

let ms_values: List[Float] = [to_float(x.ms) for x in items where x.valid_label]
let mean_ms: Int = if len(ms_values) == 0 then 0 else round_even_int(stats.mean(ms_values))
let consecutive_breaches: Int = count adjacent past, now in items where past.breach and now.breach
let spike_steps: Int = count adjacent past, now in items where now.ms > past.ms + 100
let regressed: Int = count earlier past, now in items where past.ms + 300 < now.ms
let status: Text = overall_status(consecutive_breaches, summary.critical, summary.breaches, summary.invalid_labels)

let out = record {
    count: summary.total
    breaches: summary.breaches
    overage_ms: summary.overage_ms
    max_ms: summary.max_ms
    mean_ms
    bucket_zero: summary.bucket_zero
    critical: summary.critical
    warn_or_worse: summary.warn_or_worse
    consecutive_breaches
    spike_steps
    invalid_labels: summary.invalid_labels
    exempt: summary.exempt
    regressed
    status
}

print json_encode(out)
